name: The Foundry Event Hall

seeded.where: copper (#b87333) small text on slate: capacity specs on all three space cards, footer contact line
Loft and Courtyard space photos have no alt
fixed back-to-top button contains only an SVG chevron, no accessible name
hero scroll cue is aria-hidden="true" but contains a focusable anchor
viewport meta sets maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no
best practice: hero Check availability CTA carries tabindex="1"
best practice: no h1 exists because the page's headline is the hero image (see beyondScanner)

beyondScanner: Image of text (WCAG 1.4.5): the hero headline 'HOST UNFORGETTABLE EVENTS at The Foundry' is images/hero-title.svg rendered as an . Axe stays silent because the alt attribute is present, but the page's core message is invisible to screen readers and there is no h1. The right fix is real HTML heading text (styled to match), not just an alt string.

Div-soup dropdown (WCAG 2.1.1 / 4.1.2): the main nav 'Spaces' item is <div class="nav-drop" onclick=...> toggling a submenu via classList. No button role, not focusable, no keyboard handler, no aria-expanded — keyboard and screen-reader users cannot open the Spaces menu at all. Needs a real <button> (or link) with aria-expanded and keyboard support.

Fake button (WCAG 2.1.1 / 4.1.2): 'Take the virtual tour' is a <span class="btn-ghost" onclick="location.href=..."> styled like a button. It is unreachable by keyboard and announced as plain text; it should be an <a href> since it navigates.
